name: LambdaTest Automation API
tagline: REST API for cloud browser and device testing sessions
description: LambdaTest provides a cloud-based cross-browser and real-device testing platform. Its Automation API lets developers manage Selenium/Appium/Cypress sessions, tunnels, builds, and Smart UI visual tests programmatically via REST.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with username and access key (email:accessKey), obtained from LambdaTest account settings after self-serve signup.

use_cases: fetch session video and logs by session id
trigger or query Smart UI visual regression builds
get build and test status for CI pipelines
